title: Art. 9.1 — Annex 6 Part I - Operation of Aircraft: International Commercial Air Transport - Aeroplanes, Chapter 9, Article 9.1 - Composition of flight crew, 9.1
content:
9.1 Composition of the flight crew

9.1.1 An aeroplane shall be operated with a flight crew of at least the number specified in the certificate of airworthiness, the flight manual or such other official document issued by the State of Registry.

9.1.2 The flight crew shall include flight crew members in addition to the minimum number specified in 9.1.1 when required by the type of operation.
